{"metadata":{"description":"Out-of-tree installable plugin marketplace bundle for DeepSeek Harness","id":"gh:1334782319","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-plugin-marketplace","slug":"w2112515/dsh-plugin-marketplace","topics":["deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin","plugin-marketplace"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Out-of-tree installable plugin marketplace bundle for DeepSeek Harness"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# DSH Plugin Marketplace"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**The plugin marketplace for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): browse, review, and install DSH plugins from in"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"side DSH's own Settings UI — with evidence-based install safety, consent-gated install scripts, cura"},{"id":"p3s3","text":"ted solution packs, and zero telemetry.**"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"**中文文档：README.zh-CN.md**（界面语言跟随 DSH 自动切换）"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## What is DSH Plugin Marketplace?"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"DSH Plugin Marketplace is an **out-of-tree, installable DSH bundle** that adds a full plugin marketp"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"lace to DeepSeek Harness. It is not part of the official DSH repository, requires no changes to DSH "},{"id":"p6s3","text":"source code, and is not a standalone web product. Once installed into the `web` profile, DSH's Host "},{"id":"p6s4","text":"Loader mounts the marketplace Host plugin, and the package's declared `dsh.client` browser entry reg"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"isters itself under `Settings → Plugins → Marketplace`. The UI is bilingual and follows DSH's displa"},{"id":"p6s6","text":"y language automatically (中文 / English)."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"At a glance:"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- **2,200+ plugins** discovered by a daily scan of every GitHub repository carrying the `dsh-plugin`"},{"id":"p8s2","text":" topic — no GitHub account or token needed to browse.
- **Evidence-based install eligibility**: the "},{"id":"p8s3","text":"scanner proves which install targets exist at each plugin's pinned commit, so "one-click" means *pro"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"ven installable*, not *probably fine*.
- **Consent-gated scripts**: install scripts are shown verbat"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"im and run only after explicit, per-install consent — never persisted, never bulk-approved.
- **Cura"},{"id":"p8s6","text":"ted solution packs** that install a coherent capability baseline in one reviewed action.
- **No tele"},{"id":"p8s7","text":"metry, no install counts, no server** — the catalog is static JSON on GitHub Pages."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Install into your DSH"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"From npm:"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Or pin an immutable commit from GitHub (this repository commits its built `lib/`, so no `prepare` ru"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"ns on your machine):"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Regular users need no GitHub token. Automatic installs require the Host to run `pnpm` 11 (the plugin"},{"id":"p14s2","text":" also tries `corepack pnpm`); consent-gated script installs require pnpm ≥ 11.7. When no package man"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"ager exists, the WebUI keeps browsing and shows a recovery hint instead of a fake success. Uninstall"},{"id":"p14s4","text":": `dsh plugin --profile web remove @w2112515/dsh-plugin-marketplace`."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"The default catalog is served from this repository's GitHub Pages. During development you can overri"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"fault catalog is served from this repository's GitHub Pages. During development you can override it:"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## Install safety"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Automatic installs pin an immutable 40-character commit and always go through capability preflight →"},{"id":"p18s2","text":" short-lived review plan → confirmed execution, with rollback of the profile manifest, lockfile, and"},{"id":"p18s3","text":" workspace config on failure. Eligibility is decided by evidence at the pinned commit:"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"| Catalog entry | What the scanner proved | What happens on install |"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"| **Automatic install** | Every install target (entry files, patch) exists in the pinned commit's gi"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"t tree | `pnpm add --ignore-scripts` — third-party lifecycle scripts never run |
| **Needs script re"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"view** | Targets are absent (build output not shipped), but the package declares lifecycle scripts |"},{"id":"p20s4","text":" Scripts are shown **verbatim** in the review step; after your explicit consent, the Host installs o"},{"id":"p20s5","text":"nce with `--allow-build=<name>` instead of `--ignore-scripts`, scoping script execution to exactly t"},{"id":"p20s6","text":"he reviewed package within that single invocation. Nothing is written to `allowBuilds`; consent is n"},{"id":"p20s7","text":"ever persisted |
| **Manual install** | Neither of the above | Repository link only; the marketplace"},{"id":"p20s8","text":" never runs anything |"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## Solution packs"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"A pack is a curated list of plugin repositories — nothing more. A repository becomes a pack by carry"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"ing **both** the `dsh-plugin` and `dsh-plugin-pack` topics plus a `dsh.pack.json` manifest:"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"- `items` holds 1–50 `owner/repo` strings; resolution to stable repository ids happens at scan time "},{"id":"p24s2","text":"against the catalog itself, so renames never rewrite identity silently.
- The marketplace shows ever"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"y item's explicit status — *will auto-install*, *needs script review*, *manual install*, *not in cat"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"alog*, *already installed* — and an honest `install N of M` count. Pack cards also disclose the inst"},{"id":"p24s5","text":"all composition up front (`7 one-click · 1 script-review · 1 manual`), computed from catalog truth a"},{"id":"p24s6","text":"t scan time.
- Installing a pack runs the normal single-plugin plan→execute path serially, stops at "},{"id":"p24s7","text":"the first failure, rolls nothing back, and reports each item's outcome.
- **Packs grant no privilege"},{"id":"p24s8","text":"**: script-gated items still require their own per-plugin review and consent; manual items stay manu"},{"id":"p24s9","text":"ated items still require their own per-plugin review and consent; manual items stay manual.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## Community ratings"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## Privacy stance"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"The marketplace is **read-only against a static catalog and never phones home**: no install counts, "},{"id":"p28s2","text":"no telemetry, no analytics endpoint. There is deliberately no server to collect them — the catalog i"},{"id":"p28s3","text":"s plain JSON on GitHub Pages, and every install decision happens on your machine. Popularity signals"},{"id":"p28s4","text":" come from GitHub's own public data (stars), nothing else."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"- **Distribution unit**: one npm/Git/tarball package declaring `dsh.bundle.patch`.
- **Host**: downl"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"oads and strictly validates the central static catalog (schema + integrity digest), keeps a last-kno"},{"id":"p30s3","text":"wn-good cache, and owns review and mutation of the current profile.
- **Client**: a `settings.plugin"},{"id":"p30s4","text":"s.tab` Slot contribution providing search, category filters, detail pages, risk signals, review conf"},{"id":"p30s5","text":"irmation, and solution packs.
- **Host/Client channel**: a package-private, same-origin `/api/plugin"},{"id":"p30s6","text":"-marketplace` JSON API. DSH's static Typert Remote manifest is untouched.
- **Catalog production**: "},{"id":"p30s7","text":"a daily GitHub Actions scan of repositories carrying the `dsh-plugin` topic. Only statically validat"},{"id":"p30s8","text":"ed, non-archived bundles enter the public catalog; rejects are kept in the workflow artifact. Search"},{"id":"p30s9","text":"es that hit GitHub's 1,000-result cap are bisected by creation-date windows. Only the central scanne"},{"id":"p30s10","text":"r uses the repository's own `GITHUB_TOKEN`.
- **Categories**: plugins are classified into nine categ"},{"id":"p30s11","text":"ories (theme, memory, usage, skill, security, channel, UI, tool, provider) from an explicit `dsh-cat"},{"id":"p30s12","text":"egory-<slug>` topic or conservative whole-word tokens; a plugin with no honest signal stays *uncateg"},{"id":"p30s13","text":"orized* rather than being misfiled."}],"truncated":true}
